faq.q: Is employee data safe to use with Ryu?
faq.a: Yes. With a local model, employee data stays on your machine. For cloud models, Gateway rules can block or redact personal data and log each call. Analytics and crash reports are on by default and can be turned off.

faq.q: Will policy answers be accurate to our company?
faq.a: Yes, if you add your handbook and benefits docs to a Space. Answers cite the policy section so you can check before sharing.

faq.q: Can it make HR decisions for us?
faq.a: No. Ryu drafts documents and gathers information so an HR professional can decide and finalize. The audit trail records which model ran and when.
